name: reverie
description: Rêverie is a proprietary raster painting engine built in-house by Folio Brainstorm™
author: Folio Brainstorm™

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --filter @reverie/demo build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build:debug && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --parallel --filter @reverie/core --filter @reverie/renderer --filter @reverie/web --filter @reverie/exporter --filter @reverie/demo dev
scripts.dev:no-debug: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --parallel --filter @reverie/core --filter @reverie/renderer --filter @reverie/web --filter @reverie/exporter --filter @reverie/demo dev:no-debug
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build:debug && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --filter @reverie/test test && pnpm --filter @reverie/web test && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer test && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter test
scripts.test:no-debug: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --filter @reverie/test test:no-debug && pnpm --filter @reverie/web test && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer test && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter test
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build:debug && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --parallel --filter @reverie/test --filter @reverie/web --filter @reverie/renderer --filter @reverie/exporter test:watch
scripts.test:verbose: pnpm --filter @reverie/core build:debug && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer build && pnpm --filter @reverie/web build && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter build && pnpm --filter @reverie/test test:verbose && pnpm --filter @reverie/web test:verbose && pnpm --filter @reverie/renderer test:verbose && pnpm --filter @reverie/exporter test:verbose
